title: Buy now, pay later debt on the rise. The risks you need to know before signing up
summary: Consumer Reports-sourced news segment warns shoppers to weigh the full cost of BNPL loans and watch for stacking and overdraft risk before signing up.

assertions.quote: Consumers are using Buy Now, Pay Later loans for groceries, food delivery – even utility bills and rent.
